newsitem.title: USA: Fed injects reserves via $2.0 bln customer RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed injects reserves via $2.0 bln customer RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve injected reserves into the banking system via a round of $2.0 billion customer repurchase agreements Friday.
The RPs come off the books on Monday. The Fed also has four-, 13- and 14-day fixed system repurchase agreements outstanding.
Economists said the Fed faced normal yearend pressures and still had a large add need during the second week of the current maintenance period.
Federal funds traded above target at 5-5/16 percent.
-- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1867
